summary: Zenphoto is an open-source content management system and photo gallery platform written in PHP. It provides the core functionality needed to organise and display image collections on a self-hosted web server. It operates under the GPL-2.0 licence.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice if you want a dedicated, self-hosted web application specifically structured for publishing photography collections rather than general file storage.
watchOut: The project exhibits slowing maintenance activity and lower community traction compared to mainstream alternatives, which may affect long-term security updates and bug fixes.
deployNotes: As a PHP application, it typically requires a standard web server stack such as Apache or Nginx, alongside a relational database like MySQL or MariaDB, and persistent storage for uploaded image files.
